requests.name: run
requests.prompt: Hero transformation MAID ANNA, adult female human fantasy combat maid. Canonical candidate design in EVERY sprite: long auburn-brown hair tied with a small white ribbon, white frilled maid bonnet, modest black long-sleeved dress with a white fitted frilled apron and white cuffs, dark stockings, practical black shoes, a sturdy brown wooden broom with a pale straw brush and small brass band, held with anatomically consistent hands. Same face, hair, dress, apron, broom shape and proportions in all cells. Polished readable isometric pixel art, simplified secondary cloth, transparent background with no text, labels, shadows, floor, borders or VFX. Keep the WHOLE character and broom fully INSIDE its own equal square tile, with generous empty gutters. Do not change costume or swap weapons.EXACT six columns by eight rows, preferred total1536x2048,256px square cells. Row camera headings E right,SE down-right,S down,SW down-left,W left,NW up-left,N up,NE up-right. EVERY frame within one row has the SAME fixed camera heading; back rows show the back of the head/dress, not the front. Uniform character apparent size and common projected ground anchor across cells. RUN ONLY. Six genuinely articulated running phases per row: col0 left-foot contact right leg back; col1 left-foot loading right knee forward; col2 both feet airborne switching support; col3 right-foot contact left leg back; col4 right-foot loading left knee forward; col5 both feet airborne. Clear alternating legs and independently bending knees/ankles; apron restrained and broom firmly attached to hands. No walking, no simple whole-sprite bobbing, no duplicate poses. Keep head rigid and body width constant.48 unique coherent RUN sprites.
